name: v0.3.51 — Leaner dashboard (feature pills removed)
releaseNotes:
• The top-bar logo is now our avocado mascot.
• Removed the feature-pill row from the dashboard for a cleaner, more focused home screen — your snapshot and stats lead now.
• All features are still one tap away: bottom tabs, the centre camera (Add Receipt), and the Menu (long-press for Steals, Rewards, Stash, Inbox, GuacScore, GuacWizard, and more).
